title: Harry White and the White Brothers
summary: Harry White was the White Brothers' pianist and leader, not a trombonist; Tizol thinks he played with Duke before him.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh. You should have. I found a reference to a man named Harry White who was from Washington, D.C. He was playing trombone with Duke before you joined him in New York, is that right? Do you know him?
You remember the White Brothers in Washington, D.C.
Oh, that's the White brothers -- the piano player. He was the one who used to be the leader of the group.
Oh. But he was not a trombone player?
No, the trombone player used to play with other bands; he was not in the band. I was the only trombone player with the White Brothers Band.
I think it was Stanley Dance's book that mentions that. Yeah. In Stanley Dance's book, in an interview with Barney Bigard, it mentions Harry White.
There were three brothers who were musicians; Harry, the saxophone player, and the piano player.
I see. Because it says, 'Before Tizol
came in to the band, he had another guy from Washington -- Harry White -- on trombone". But Harry White, did he actually play with Duke before you came?
I think so; I think so.
